bagPolicy.summary: For safety and speed of entry, bags are discouraged at events. Purses up to 12” x 12” x 6” are allowed at designated X-ray entry points. Wristlets, clutches, or wallets 4” x 6” x 1.5” or smaller are permitted at all entrances.
allowed: Purses no larger than 12” x 12” x 6”
Wristlet, clutch or wallets 4” x 6” x 1.5” or smaller
bagPolicy.note: Medical and parenting bags are permitted and subject to X-ray screening.

parking.note: Parking is available at RiverCentre and Kellogg Parking Ramps, both connected to the arena. Event day parking is first come, first served, and ParkWhiz reservations are not available for these ramps.

rideshare.note: Gate 4 on 5th Street is the official pick-up and drop-off location for ride share services.

concessions.note: Xcel Energy Center offers a variety of food and drink options including traditional sausages, craft beers, pizza, burgers, and more. Special offerings include the Wild $6 Happy Hour and the Wild Market with Amazon’s Just Walk Out technology. Alcohol sales end during the third period of Minnesota Wild games or one hour before the end of other events.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Current official guidance confirms that accessibility arrangements are handled by Xcel Energy Center, but event-specific services may require advance coordination. Contact the venue before purchasing if you need accessible seating, mobility assistance, interpreting, assistive-listening support, or another accommodation.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Xcel Energy Center's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at Xcel Energy Center. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Xcel Energy Center. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
